pins.pin_title: How to request your family's police case file: a free step-by-step guide
pins.description: A free guide to requesting police records and case files for an old family case, from a daughter who requested her dad's. Find the right agency, what to say when you call, how to write the request, how to ask them to leave out photos, and what to do when something is missing. Includes a copy-and-paste request template.
pins.alt: Cream pin titled How to Request Your Family's Case File, with five numbered steps. Not Plain.

pins.label: Public records
pins.title_image: Requesting Police Records for an Old Case: Start Here
pins.quote: Call the department's non-emergency number and ask: "How do I submit a public records request for an old case?"
pins.pin_title: How to request police records for an old case: where to start
pins.description: The first step in requesting old police records or a family member's case file: call the department's non-emergency number and ask how to submit a public records request. From a free guide by a daughter who requested her dad's case file, with tips on cost, timing, photos and follow-up requests.
pins.alt: Cream pin titled Requesting Police Records for an Old Case: Start Here, with a tip to call the non-emergency number first. Not Plain.

pins.label: Copy and paste template
pins.quote: Dear Custodian of Records, Under [your state's public records law], I am requesting copies of all public records related to [agency] Case #[number, if known]...
pins.pin_title: Free public records request template for police case files
pins.description: A free, copy-and-paste public records request template for requesting a police case file: incident reports, statements, recordings and other agency records, plus a line asking them to leave out photos you don't want to see. Part of a free guide to requesting your family's case files.
pins.alt: Cream pin titled Free Public Records Request Template, showing the first lines of a records request letter. Not Plain.
